title: Operations Executive
description:
Operations Executive to coordinate daily dispatch and customer communication.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate with drivers and warehouse staff on daily dispatch.
- Handle customer queries about shipment status over phone and email.
- Maintain daily reporting in Excel.

Requirements:
- Required: 1-3 years in operations, logistics coordination or customer support.
- Must have working knowledge of MS Excel.
- Good communication in Bengali and Hindi is required.
